item.title: v0.0.0-rc-4
item.description:
What's new

  • Choose who can message your bots. A bot's Access tab lists the people and groups that may use it; others can ask, and you allow or decline.
  • Find people by username. Type someone's whole @username in search to start a chat with them; pick your own in Settings › Profile.
  • Bots write artifacts, you comment. Select text in an artifact and press Comment to send it to the bot that wrote it; Multiple comments collects several and sends them together.
  • HTML pages run sealed. On Mac and iPhone an HTML artifact opens in a sandbox with no network and just a floating Comment button over it; Details lists what it tried to reach. On Windows and Linux you see its source.
  • Code in colour. Code blocks and code files are coloured by language, line numbers stay out of copies, and Compare shows what changed between two versions.
  • Artifacts never hide your chats. On desktop the chat list narrows instead of disappearing when an artifact is open, and Full screen gives a document the whole window.
  • A new photo and video viewer. Zoom, move through a chat's photos and videos, copy or save them; on desktop a click outside the picture closes it. Videos play with sound, with Picture in Picture on Mac, Windows and iPhone.
  • Paste and drop files. Paste images and files straight into the message box, or drop files on a chat in the list to send them there.
  • Emoji panel on iPhone. 😊 swaps the keyboard for an emoji panel, sized like the iPhone keyboard, with search and your recent emoji.
  • Share to Tiny Hive. On iPhone your recent chats can show as suggestions in the Share sheet, and sharing from Finder and Photos sends again.
  • New colours. Settings › Appearance pairs a mode (Light, Dark or System) with a colour: Nord, Midnight or the new Grape.
  • Bots do more. They show their own picture everywhere, vote in polls, see the reactions on their messages, and start a chat with someone on their list when you ask.
  • Chats keep up with you. A draft started on one device waits on your others, a group opens on the topic you were in, and your own messages sit in a light block.
  • Info has its own column. One way in from the chat header, with the picture at the top; Stop for a working bot now lives in Bot info.
  • Steadier sending. × on a sending photo stops it in place and Resume sends only what is missing; polls keep your draft, silent messages never ring, and a forward no longer shows the chat it came from.
  • Calls on iPhone keep going. Leaving the app or locking the phone no longer ends a call, the screen stays on while you talk, and your other devices stay quiet meanwhile.
  • Back online sooner. The app reconnects a few seconds after the network returns and a short drop no longer flashes "Waiting for network…"; compacts show while they run, and a bot no longer looks stuck after a compact and restart.
  • Other channels, one row each. A bot's Telegram channels, groups and chats are listed; open one to read its messages.
  • On Mac. The Dock icon counts unread messages, and an old background process that hangs no longer blocks Tiny Hive from opening.
